name: whoville-client-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end test suite for the Whoville-Client Angular 11.2.5 application. Greenfield E2E initiative providing a regression safety net for the planned Angular 11 -> 21 migration. Implements the 3-tier (Smoke / Feature CRUD / Integration) execution model and the Patterns A-E config-driven test templates documented in the Agent Action Plan.

scripts.e2e:cleanup-storage-states: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='e2e/storage-states';if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.readdirSync(p).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).forEach(f=>fs.unlinkSync(`${p}/${f}`));console.log('Cleaned storage states.');}else{console.log('No storage-states directory.');}"

doNotForget: Keep all @playwright/* packages in lock-step (per Playwright docs).
Run 'npx playwright install --with-deps' after any Playwright version bump.
Regenerate e2e/storage-states/*.json (gitignored) via global-setup.ts before any tier run.
Refresh e2e/fixtures/api-responses/**/*.json quarterly via E2E_API_MODE=live nightly run.
Update e2e/utils/route-inventory.ts whenever new application routes are added.

playwright-ng-schematics is OPTIONAL and intentionally NOT pinned here; add it when the Angular CLI integration is wired in (its current 21.x major couples to Angular 21 schematic API and is not compatible with Angular 11 - revisit during the Angular 11 -> 21 migration).
